name: Data.intValuation_pi
summary: Apply `Parameters.intValuation_eq_of_mul_star` to the prime N(D) ≡ 1 mod N₁(D)·d(P) and a = π(D), with π(D)·conj(π(D)) = N(D)·1.

steps.claim: By `Parameters.intValuation_eq_of_mul_star` for the prime p = N(D), which is ≡ 1 mod N₁(D)·d(P) (`Data.N_modEq_one`), and a = π(D): the w-adic valuation of π(D) is exp(−1) once N(D) ∈ w, π(D)·conj(π(D)) = N(D)·c with c prime to N(D), and π(D) ∈ w are given.
steps.lean:
Parameters.intValuation_eq_of_mul_star D.N_modEq_one
  (D.π_mul_star ▸ w.1.mul_mem_right _ h) ⟨1, by simp [π_mul_star]⟩ h

steps.claim: N(D) ∈ w: N(D) = π(D)·conj(π(D)) (`Data.π_mul_star`) and π(D) ∈ w (h), so the product lies in the ideal w.
π(D)·conj(π(D)) = N(D)·c with c = 1, and N(D) is prime to 1.
